title: improv·artist · gestural (Cy Twombly)
mutation_directive: improv artist: gestural via Cy Twombly

improv_extras.practice: scribble as handwriting; smeared chalk on cream; eros, mythology, illegibility

v1.feedback: The Twombly mapping is genuinely thoughtful — boid trails as accumulating chalk-marks on parchment, the straggler's terracotta blood vs graphite flock, and the mythological-cycle narrative arc all land. Two refinements: (1) the trail jitter is uniform random rather than directional pressure-wobble — real chalk tremor correlates with velocity direction, so offset perpendicular to the velocity vector for more convincing gestural marks; (2) with 481 boids × 40 trail points the density may flatten into ambient texture rather than distinct scribble-strokes — consider reducing boid count to ~120 but lengthening trails to ~80 so individual gesture-lines remain legible as handwriting rather than dissolving into fog.

threejs.directive: Use Line2/LineMaterial (fat lines) for trails — per-vertex linewidth maps boid speed to chalk pressure, giving Twombly-grade gestural thickness variation that GL_LINES cannot.
